article.story: No. 15 Tennessee (4-1) at Arkansas (2-3), Oct. 10 at 4:15 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Tennessee by 13.5. Against the spread: Tennessee 3-2, Arkansas 1-4. How to watch: SEC Network Key stats Tennessee Offense Overall: 415 yards per game (56th in FBS) Passing: 174.4 yards per game (119th) Rushing: 240.6 yards per game (14th) Scoring: 36.8 points per game (34th) Tennessee Defense Overall: 295 yards per game (29th in FBS) Passing: 162.6 yards per game (20th) Rushing: 132.4 yards per game (60th) Scoring: 15.2 points per game (20th) Arkansas Offense Overall: 335 yards per game (116th in FBS) Passing: 242.8 yards per game (58th) Rushing: 92.2 yards per game (134th) Scoring: 19.8 points per game (115th) Arkansas Defense Overall: 340 yards per game (58th in FBS) Passing: 194 yards per game (51st) Rushing: 146 yards per game (79th) Scoring: 28.4 points per game (108th) Arkansas is 120th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 45% of third downs. Arkansas ranks 104th in the FBS with a -3 turnover margin, compared to Tennessee's 34th-ranked +3 margin. Tennessee ranks 89th in the FBS averaging 61.4 penalty yards per game, compared to Arkansas' 33rd-ranked 48.4 per-game average. Arkansas is 103rd in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 90.5% of trips. Tennessee's red zone offense ranks 1st, scoring on 100% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders Tennessee Passing: Faizon Brandon, 697 yards, 7 TDs, 1 INT, 60.4 completion percentage Rushing: DeSean Bishop, 540 yards on 88 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Mike Matthews, 318 yards on 18 catches, 3 TDs Arkansas Passing: K.J. Jackson, 1,038 yards, 6 TDs, 4 INTs, 60.5 completion percentage Rushing: Braylen Russell, 136 yards on 40 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Chris Marshall, 549 yards on 35 catches, 2 TDs Last game Tennessee won 24-14 over Auburn on Oct. 3. George MacIntyre threw for 86 yards on 8-of-10 attempts (80.0%) with no touchdowns and no interceptions. Bishop carried the ball 34 times for 220 yards and scored three touchdowns. Matthews put up 57 yards on four catches. Arkansas fell to Texas A&M 34-7 on Oct. 3. Jackson led Arkansas with 111 yards on 13-of-25 passing (52.0%) for one touchdown and one interception. Sutton Smith carried the ball six times for 41 yards, adding five receptions for 24 yards. Marshall put up 76 yards on seven catches with one touchdown. Next game Tennessee hosts No. 6 Alabama on Oct. 17. Arkansas plays at Vanderbilt on Oct. 17.
